manifest.coverageNote: 按来源类别和有限范围导入，并非全球完整景点清单。多来源未确定的实体重叠保留。
manifest.taxonomyMethod: Wikidata P31/P279*、Overture旅游类别、OSM标签及人工核验多标签
manifest.searchNote: 中文、英文、来源别名、细分类和已核实行政归属进入Worker索引。
manifest.countryCountNote: 实际有地点记录的国家/地区代码数，包含旅行地区，不等于主权国家数。
manifest.databaseLicense: ODbL-1.0 for the merged database; independent source and photo licenses retained
manifest.freshnessNote: 导入时间、来源快照和营业核验日期分别记录，未知源快照日期不推测。
manifest.qualityNote: 知名范围依据官方5A/已核验4A名录、世界遗产与编辑精选；组成地点不等同于独立评级，非游客评分或实时热度。
manifest.informationScopeNote: 官方整体的代表位置不赋予来源游览点的营业、票务、照片或观赏资料；这些资料保留在具体地点。

statusDefinitions.matched: 官方名称对应已核对的规范实体；只核对身份及位置，不代表已取得完整运营边界。
statusDefinitions.partial: 已核对自然主体/具体组成景点或独立旅游POI及真实位置；景区运营范围仍不完整。
statusDefinitions.unresolved: 缺乏可靠实体、有效位置或省份/组成关系证据；不生成伪造的地图位置。

deduplication.limitations: No fuzzy/brand-only matching. Remaining non-QID records may overlap; no claim that every unmatched provider record is a distinct real-world destination.

limitations: Finite type/country limits; no global completeness claim.
Chinese labels/aliases only when actually present in source; no machine translations.
Wikidata mountain snow classification only for explicit source label containing 雪山.
Area records use representative source coordinates, not invented extents.
OSM/Divisions-derived files require ODbL attribution/share-alike where applicable.
No travel months or official opening times inferred; no photo URLs without per-file credits.
Overture confidence is existence confidence, not proof of tourism suitability or correct classification.
Continent uses disclosed geographic convention for cross-continent or overseas countries.
Remaining non-QID provider records can contain unresolved duplicates; their count is not proof of unique real-world attractions.

p131AdministrativeEnrichment.selection: all CN/HK QIDs, first 2000 numerical QIDs per other scoped tourist country; exact P131+ and source instance/subclass administrative/city classes
p131AdministrativeEnrichment.geometryCoverage: Only Overture China regions have actual polygons; WD nodes outside polygon scope have explicit ancestry and optional source coordinate only.

coordinateTransform.method: Iterative numerical inverse of the public approximate GCJ-02 forward transform (coordtransform), 1e-9 degree convergence; approximate WGS84, original source retained
coordinateTransform.accuracyNote: Numerical convergence validates inversion only; original positional accuracy and mathematical approximation remain source limitations.

limitations: 2022 retrieval snapshot; no claim of current opening/status, hours, months or complete coverage.
Only source fine labels mapped; empty or generic 公园/山川/山水/江河湖泊/摄影 categories skipped.
SourceCityName comes from research reverse geocoding; no city boundary/P131 ancestry invented.
English names are source machine translations, not official English names.
Only mainland province polygons available; missing/ambiguous boundaries omitted.
No review text, itinerary personal data, photographs or unverified marketing-season tags imported.
